title: A request to staff a programme (the file the request page saves)
description: What a programme manager asks for (decision 0034). It arrives by mail through the sign-off mailbox, whose connector vouches for the sender, or by `teachermodel request new`. Region is required unless the mode is remote (`requests.problems` checks that and the dates). It names no instructor: who teaches is the training function's to propose.
